name: @threa/remote-session
description: The Threa remote-session SDK: everything a connector needs to bridge an interactive agent runtime (Claude Code, Pi, future Hermes/OpenClaw-style clients) to a Threa scratchpad — identity derivation, the bot HTTP client, attachment plumbing, and the full session loop (claiming, steer/stop, presence, idle timeouts). A connector implements deliverTurn + an optional session-control actuator; the SDK does the rest.
